nodes.label: Design System/Colors
nodes.rationale: The color palette is designed to be modern, energetic, and accessible, supporting both light and dark themes via CSS variables in src/index.css. This architectural choice centralizes theming and enables runtime theme switching without recompilation.

nodes.label: CSS Variables Theming (light/dark)
nodes.rationale: Colors are defined as CSS variables under :root and .dark selectors, enabling single-source theming that propagates through all Tailwind utility classes. This avoids duplicating color definitions and makes theme switching a CSS-only operation.

nodes.label: Design System/Introduction
nodes.rationale: The design system is positioned as the single source of truth for UI components — a living document that evolves with the project. This drives all subsequent component development to conform to shared tokens and patterns.

nodes.label: Design System Sections (Design System / UI / Components / Pages)

nodes.label: Design Principles (Consistent / Reusable / Accessible / Efficient)
nodes.rationale: Four core principles govern all design work: consistency ensures predictable behavior, reusability reduces duplication, accessibility guarantees usability for all, and efficiency speeds up development via a shared library.

nodes.label: Design System/Typography
nodes.rationale: Typography uses the Inter font family (configured in tailwind.config.ts) chosen for readability and modern aesthetic. Tailwind utility classes map directly to design tokens, keeping typography consistent without writing custom CSS.
